title: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0)
question: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0) and have the RBAC permission action set to "access_as_external", list the network name and the dense rank of each network when ordered by the RBAC action, using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT n.name,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.action ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank
FROM networks n
JOIN externalnetworks e ON e.network_id = n.id
JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id
WHERE e.is_default = 0
  AND r.action = 'access_as_external'
